help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:528
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:529  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:530  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:531  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:532
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:533  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:534  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:535  * no run recorded at all, or nothing has run for longer than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:536    4x `backup_interval_secs` (minimum 1 hour) -> exit 1. A dead timer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:537    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:538    is the only thing that catches it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:539
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:540  Never prints session content: counts, timestamps and digests only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:541
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:542  Default output is a handful of lines and nothing more: the verdict
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:543  above, then aggregate scan counts (per-harness session totals, skipped
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:544  roots, unarchivable-session warning). It stays that size whether the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:545  machine holds three sessions or three thousand, so the verdict never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:546  scrolls away.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:547
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:548  `--sessions` adds the per-session metadata table on top of that —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:549  one line per session (harness / bytes / mtime / first 8 chars of the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:550  id). That is the troubleshooting view; it can be hundreds of lines.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:552  Also print one metadata line per session found (can be hundreds).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:555  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:556  human lines still go to stderr). Tri-state fields are tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:557  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:558  `{"kind":"not_applicable",…}` — an unknown is never serialised as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:559  `0`, `null` or a missing field. `run_state.kind` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:560  `known` / `missing` / `unreadable`; `scanner.kind` is `ok` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561  `failed`. `exit_semantics` documents what the exit code means.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:564  Also list archived per-machine writer versions from a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567  Repository path override for archived writer versions.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  Masterkey file override for archived writer versions.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:573  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:576  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:579  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:583  Read one session from the repository (sequence-concatenated) and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:584  report its length and sha256 without printing content. With `--all-machines`, walk
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:585  **every snapshot of every machine** cumulatively and report per-session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:586  digests.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:588  Local stage directory to compare the read against. Optional: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  session's bytes always come from the archive, addressed by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:590  `--machine` and `--session`, and this only adds an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:591  `expected src` sha256 computed from the shards on this machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:592  disk. It does **not** have to be the archiving machine's stage root,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:593  and a path that does not exist merely leaves that line uncomputed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:594  Ignored by `--all-machines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:597  Native session id to dump, e.g. `019bf00d-...`. Resolved against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:598  every snapshot of `--machine`, newest first, so a session reclaimed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:599  out of the stage is still readable. Ignored by `--all-machines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:602  Cross-machine merge, cumulative: for every hostname, every snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:603  (`sessions/<machine>/…`), each session's shards sequence-joined and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:604  hashed. Newest copies per shard path win; older sequences absent from
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:605  newer snapshots remain included. Prints ids, counts, lengths, and sha256 only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:608  Print full session ids in per-session rows (default: privacy-safe short ids).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:611  Show every stored shard. Default reads collapse the copies a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:612  proven re-seal leaves — a copy that replays kept shards at the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:613  same archived sequence numbers — while retaining verified
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  sequence-bound captures, including identical captured bodies.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  Nothing is deleted by either policy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:618  ADR-061: also emit the records the source deleted, at their
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:619  original positions, each carrying `"deleted": true`. The default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:620  view stays the source's final state; this switch is how the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:621  deleted history — still stored, never erased — becomes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622  reachable. Snapshot-source sessions (opencode) only; other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  harnesses ignore the switch (their bodies are growth logs).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:626  Serve this read from the local mirror copy only (W1053): the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:627  destination is never contacted — no connection is opened at all
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:628  — and every byte answers from the mirror, the body cache or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:629  rustic's local metadata cache. A file none of them holds reports
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:630  "did not finish" (exit `3`) rather than reaching for the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:631  remote, so an offline absence is unknown, never empty, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:632  report says `served from mirror`. Requires a usable mirror of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:633  the destination being read; refused before anything is read
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:634  when there is none.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:637  Machine partition to read. Uses this machine's id when available;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:638  if it is unavailable, use `--machine` explicitly. Unused by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  `--all-machines`, which reads every machine.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  Named destination from the config. Required once the config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643  declares any destination; there is no default.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:665  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else. Tri-state
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:666  fields are tagged `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}`

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:674  Prove the archive is intact. Three independently runnable levels:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:675  l1 = rustic structure check (cheap, no payload reads), l2 = rustic content
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:676  check (downloads and re-hashes every pack), l3 = reconcile against an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:677  expected manifest derived from the sealed staging tree (per session:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:678  shard count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:680  Which level(s) to run: `l1`, `l2`, `l3` or `all`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:683  Stage directory holding the sealed shard tree (required by l3 / all).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:686  Print full session ids in L3 rows (default: privacy-safe short ids).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:689  Certify the local mirror copy instead of the destination (W1053):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:690  the destination is never contacted — the copy answers every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:691  read, and the verdict that comes back certifies **the copy**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  never the destination's repository, so it is worded that way
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:693  and the report says `served from mirror`. L1/L2 grade the copy's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:694  own integrity: packs the copy lacks its index name are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  copy's own finding, exit 1. L3 reconciles the stage against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  what the copy holds, and a session the copy never synced is an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:697  unknown about the archive — a `NOT IN THE LOCAL COPY` row and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  RESULT INCOMPLETE, exit 3 — never `MISSING IN ARCHIVE`, which a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699  not-contacted destination cannot prove. An online `verify` (no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:700  switch) still never consults the copy.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:748  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:752  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:753
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:754  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:755  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:757  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:758  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:760  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:761  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:762  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:765  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:793  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:797  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:799  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:803  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:804
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:806  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:807  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:809  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:810  In a separate metadata-only run, use `--cost` to estimate the payload
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  size before choosing a full-text mode. `--scan` reads those payloads;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  `--text` uses the local index and checks that it covers the selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:813  sessions before treating zero hits as a complete answer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:818  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:819  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:821  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:822  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:829  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:830
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  `--surface` filters on the **observed** surface dimension (ADR-059):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:832  a session matches only if its records name the value — claude-code's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:833  Cowork transcripts record `desktop-cowork` — and a session whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  records carry no surface at all (the CLI library records none: an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:835  absent observation is never read as an implicit `cli`) is listed as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:836  unplaceable while the filter is active. The value must be one the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:837  registry declares in its `dimensions.surfaces` (`cli`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:838  `desktop-cowork`, …); anything else is a usage error, because a typo
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:839  named as a filter must not come back as an empty result. With the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  flag absent every surface is in scope and the search behaves exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:841  as it did before the dimension existed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:842
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  `--text` searches the local FTS5 trigram index (substring matching for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  runs of at least three characters). A shorter query is refused, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:845  answered: the report says `matched=unknown` and the run exits `3`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  `--scan` reads selected conversations and matches them as plain text
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  instead; it answers short queries, at the cost of reading them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:848
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:849  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:850  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:851  destination and answered for every session with no match, `3` could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:852  finish — reading it, placing every session in time, or evaluating the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:853  query — so a zero proves nothing. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:858  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / surface / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  Search indexed titles and user/assistant text with SQLite's trigram tokenizer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  Read selected sessions and perform a case-insensitive substring scan.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  Emit one JSON object on stdout. Metadata searches include separate
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  matched / not matched / could-not-be-placed groups; text searches
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  carry coverage, read failures and a `query_state` for the query.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:887  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:891  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:892
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:894  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:895  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:896  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:905  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:907
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:908  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:924  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:925  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:928  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:934  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / surface / time window),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  resolved by the same code as `search` — a `--surface` value the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  registry does not declare is refused here too.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:940  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:942  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:945  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:946  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  ADR-061: also emit the records the source deleted, at their
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:951  original positions, each carrying `"deleted": true`. The default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:952  view stays the source's final state; this switch is how the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  deleted history — still stored, never erased — becomes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:954  reachable. Snapshot-source sessions (opencode) only; other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:955  harnesses ignore the switch (their bodies are growth logs).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:958  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:959  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:962  Write every stored shard. By default the copies a proven re-seal
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963  leaves are collapsed out of the body — a run that replays kept
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:964  shards under the same archived sequence numbers another machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  instance already held. The archive is never modified either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:969  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  Serve the export from the local mirror copy only (W1053): the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:973  destination is never contacted, and the report says
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:974  `served from mirror`. A selected session whose bytes the copy
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  does not hold is listed in the manifest's failed sessions with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:976  an unknown-worded reason and makes the run exit `3` (incomplete
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:977  — it never reads as "the archive does not have it").
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:980  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:983  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:986  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:989  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:992  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:996  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:997  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:998
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:999  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1000  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1001  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1002  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1003
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1004  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1005  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1006  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1007  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1008  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1009  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1010  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1011
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1012  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1013  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1014  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1015  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1016  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1017  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1018  codes: 0 served the dashboard — even an archive that holds nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1019  which is served as an honest empty page rather than not starting; 3
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1020  could not finish reading (or no key), and is also the exit status after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1021  serving an archive that could not be read in full; 2 is a usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1024  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1026  Backfill the audit sidecar from historical sealed bodies without rewriting them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1028  Stage receiving the derived sidecar; source bodies remain untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1031  Partition owned by this writer.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1037  Scan only the stage, explicitly excluding historical destination bodies.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1047  Import an official export — or one harness's local-cache backup.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1048
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1049  Two modes share this command.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1050
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1051  **Takeout mode** (with a `<platform>` and `<export>`): archive the file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1052  byte-exact, and — where the platform's conversation import is open in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1053  this build — write one inbox bundle per conversation into a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1054  inbox. Claude's run reads `<export>` whole, stores it under
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1055  `<stage>/import-raw/<platform>/<sha256>` — a sibling of `sessions/`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1056  so it is in no session count — and writes one `chat-stasher/inbox@3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1057  `web-capture` bundle per conversation into `--inbox`, for a later
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1058  `ingest --inbox` to seal. This mode never seals, never pushes, never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1059  reads the config or a destination, and never modifies or moves the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1060  export file.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1061
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1062  Grok's run is held by this build's development import gate at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1063  **raw-export archiving only**: the export is parsed and sealed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1064  byte-exact as its own object under
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1065  `<stage>/export-files/<platform>/<sha256>/<name>`, its index row
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1066  files under `meta/<machine>/`, and **no conversation bundle is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1067  written** — the refused half is what the run says in its output.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1068  `--machine` names the partition that index row belongs to and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1069  required for such a platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1070
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1071  Claude's `conversations.json` and Grok's `prod-grok-backend.json`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1072  have parsers in this build; naming any other platform is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1073  refusal, not a guess.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1074
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1075  **Backup-restore mode** (`--harness grok-bot --from <dir>`): feed a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1076  copied Grok Bot cache — one backup directory, several, overlapping
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1077  ones, whatever was copied aside — into the archive once, as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1078  first-class pass instead of a `[harness_roots]` workaround. Each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1079  session found in the backup is delivered through its own delivered-set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1080  identity (machine + agent uuid), so only rows that session has never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1081  archived are sealed: a backup that overlaps the live cache or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1082  earlier import adds exactly its new rows, once. Re-running the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1083  import delivers nothing. The backup is only ever read; the live cache
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1084  is never touched, and the ordinary collect after an import still
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1085  delivers only what is genuinely new. Each sealed shard's `_chat_stasher`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1086  line records that it came from a backup import, the backup directory's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1087  basename and the import time. `--dry-run` reports the per-session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1088  counts and writes nothing anywhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1089
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1090  Exit codes (both modes): `0` = everything was read to the end and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1091  imported (takeout mode: everything this build lets the run write was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1092  written) · `3` = an input was never read to the end, so nothing about
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1093  what it holds is proven · `2` = it was read and is not something this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1094  build imports, or an argument was missing or unusable · `1` = it was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1095  read, and a conversation, session, write, or the platform's import
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1096  gate refused the rest — what was written is real but the run is

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1235  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1236  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1239  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1242  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1246  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1247  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4; ADR-060's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1248  health-gated proof).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1249
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1250  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1251  Every declared destination is first classified from its last
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1252  successful push against its degrade-after (per-destination override,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1253  else the `[reclaim]` global, default 7 days): `healthy` destinations
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1254  — and, fail-safe, a destination whose push record is unreadable —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1255  must prove; a destination whose last successful push is older than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1256  its degrade-after, or with no push on record, is degraded: not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1257  consulted for proof, listed and alarmed on every run with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1258  two-road advice (repair the push, or remove the destination from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1259  config). The command then retires the shard body once every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1260  must-prove destination proves it holds each session. Proof means
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1261  asking the archive itself — never the local cursor — for the digest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1262  triple (shard count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1263  matching it against the stage. A must-prove destination that cannot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1264  be consulted is "unproven" and blocks: it is never treated as "does
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1265  not have it". If no destination can prove at all, nothing is deleted
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1266  either — the ≥1 guard.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1267
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1268  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1269  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1270  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1271  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1272  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1273
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1274  The stage-cap alarm (`[reclaim] stage_cap_bytes`, default 10 GiB)
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1275  prints when the stage is over it, and it is an alarm only — never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1276  stop, never a forced reclaim.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1277
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1278  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1279  blocked — a must-prove destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1280  to hold a session, or no destination was healthy to prove at all, so
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1281  nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1283  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1286  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1289  Repository path override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1292  Masterkey file override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1295  Concurrency cap override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1298  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1301  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1305  Mirror the declared destination onto this machine (ADR-062 / LM-2).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1306
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1307  A mirror is a byte-exact, file-by-file copy of one declared remote
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1308  destination's whole repository, on local disk under the data
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1309  directory, ciphertext only: `config`, `keys/`, `index/`, `snapshots/`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1310  and `data/` — everything except `locks/`, which this build never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1311  holds. Copying a repo also copies its encrypted master key, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1312  the same key the destination already uses, not a new one, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1313  copy never decrypts anything: every file except `config` is verified
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1314  by hashing the bytes against the file's own name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1315
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1316  One run is one round (W964's discipline): it lists the remote,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1317  downloads what the mirror lacks, and stops where the round's budget
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1318  `--budget-secs` (default 600) says, leaving the next round to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1319  resume from the same listing-diff — progress is recorded every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1320  round, and a stopped round is reported, never counted as a failure.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1321  The hourly pass runs the same copy after its push, inside that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1322  round's leftover budget.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1323
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1324  Before a first fill starts it estimates whether the remaining
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1325  download plus the free-disk floor (`[mirror] min_free_gib`, default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1326  max(10 GiB, min(5% of the volume's capacity, 20 GiB))) fits the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1327  free space, and refuses with both numbers when it does not.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1328  Mid-round, free space falling below the floor pauses the copy
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1329  instead of writing toward a full disk.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1330
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1331  Exit codes: 0 = the mirror holds everything the remote listed;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1332  3 = the round stopped or refused and made no progress it did not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1333  verify (budget spent, disk floor, remote unreadable, space
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1334  pre-estimate refused — the next round resumes); 1 = a finished
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1335  read that failed (the source proved corrupt, a refused local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1336  write, the listing named a file over the whole-file bound, or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1337  the mirror volume's free space could not be queried);
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1338  2 = usage error (unconfigured, switch off, an undeclared
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1339  `mirror_of`, an uninitialised destination, or the destination's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1340  masterkey file missing on this machine or unusable) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1341  was read or written there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1346  Report the packs one destination's backend holds that **no index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1347  names** — what a push killed between its packs and its index strands —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1348  and say what the next push would do about each. Deletes nothing; there
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1349  is no mode in this build that deletes.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1350
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1351  Dry run is the only mode. `--apply` is refused with exit `3`, naming
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1352  what a safe delete would need and this build does not have: a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1353  repository-wide lock every client honors, a conditional delete carrying
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1354  an object version, and a trustworthy backend modification time to age
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1355  candidates by. "Unindexed" means no index file names the pack, not that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1356  the pack is unused — a retry can reuse one and write a snapshot that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1357  depends on it while it stays unindexed on disk — so the gap is real, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1358  a formality.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1359
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1360  Every pack it reports gets the shared interrupted-push
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1361  classification: bytes that verify complete are **stranded** — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1362  next open adopts them; bytes that cannot be read as a pack at all
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1363  are **torn debris** from an interrupted push, which belongs to no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1364  backup and can be ignored. Anything else is **unknown**, with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1365  verifier's reason — the one state that makes the survey incomplete.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1366
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1367  Reads only: nothing is written to the repository, to an index file or to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1368  a pack. The report carries the repository fingerprint, the backend family,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1369  pack and byte totals, the unindexed packs by id prefix and size, what the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1370  next push would adopt, and any pack an index names that the backend does
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1371  not list — and never a path, host, machine, account or conversation text.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1372
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1373  Exit codes: 0 = the survey read every pack, torn debris included — it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1374  is a known state, not an unfinished read; 1 = it read everything and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1375  found an index naming a pack the backend does not list; 3 = it did
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1376  not finish reading — a pack or an index file could not be read, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1377  backend was unreachable, or `--apply` was asked for — no absence in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1378  the output proves anything; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1380  Named destination from the config. Required unless `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1383  Check the destination and stop: no repository is opened and nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1384  is deleted. This is what happens without the flag too.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1387  Refused. Present so that asking to delete gets an answer that names
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1388  what a safe delete would need, rather than an unknown-flag error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1391  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1392  Candidate packs carry their full id, for audit; the human report

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1412  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1413  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1414
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1415  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1416  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1417  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1418  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1419
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1420  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1421  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1422  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1423  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1424  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1425  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1426
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1427  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1428  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1429
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1430  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1431  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1432  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1433  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1434  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1436  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1437  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1438  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1441  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1442  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1443  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1446  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1449  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1450  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1451  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1454  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1457  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1460  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1463  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1466  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1469  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1470  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1471  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1472  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1473  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1474  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1478  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1479
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1480  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1481  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1482  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1483  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1484  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1485
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1486  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1487  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1488  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1489  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1490  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1491
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1492  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1493  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1494  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1496  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1500  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1501
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1502  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1503  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1504  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1505  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1506  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1507  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1508
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1509  With `--rebuild --destination`, the index is rebuilt from the archive,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1510  which is all a machine whose stage is gone still needs: no source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1511  machine, and no copy of its stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1512
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1513  What that rebuild does depends on which partition is named and on
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1514  whether there is a stage to restore into, because a partition's index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1515  written by the machine that owns it (ADR-017):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1516
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1517  * **This machine's own partition, with a `--stage` directory** — every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1518    archived session is restored to a temporary child of it, the full
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1519    index is rebuilt and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1520    snapshots stay immutable; nothing is pushed until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1521    restore finish. A same-machine snapshot found before publication
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1522    restarts the rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1523  * **Any other machine, or any machine when there is no stage directory
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1524    to restore into** — the rebuild is **read-only**. That machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1525    archived sessions are read cumulatively across its snapshots and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1526    rows are written to a derived index in this machine's cache (the path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1527    is printed). The destination is not modified at all: no snapshot is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1528    appended and no path in the named machine's partition is written,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1529    because no record authorizes one machine to rewrite another's.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1530
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1531  Both modes are safe to re-run, and neither is resumable: each run starts
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1532  over. A read-only run needs the destination and the masterkey, and no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1533  `--stage` at all — which is how a machine whose stage is gone, this one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1534  included, still derives its index from the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1535
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1536  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1537  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1538  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1539  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1540  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1541
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1542  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1543  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1544  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1545  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1546  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1547  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1548  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1549  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1550
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1551  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1552  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1553  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1554  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1555  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1556  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1558  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1559  destination rebuild of **this** machine's own partition (temporary
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1560  restored shards are removed after the new snapshot is written).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1561  Omitted, or not a directory, the rebuild restores nothing and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1562  read-only for any machine, this one included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1565  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1566  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1567  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1570  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. Repair workflows
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1571  and investigation want the predictable hammer — every session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1572  re-derived from its bytes, whatever the previous index says — and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1573  this spelling makes that intent visible. Required for destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1574  (`--destination`/`--repo`) rebuilds. A local `--stage` build
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1575  defaults to this and only this unless `--incremental` is passed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1578  Update the index incrementally instead of rebuilding it: sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1579  whose bodies and inputs provably did not change since the last
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1580  build keep their measured row; everything else is re-derived as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1581  full rebuild would. Local `--stage` builds only; the result must
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1582  stay byte-identical to a full rebuild. `run-once` uses this path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1583  for its pre-push index build.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1586  Destination to rebuild from. Requires `--rebuild`; either this or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1587  `--repo` must be named. Appends the repaired snapshot when the named
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1588  `--machine` is this machine's own partition and `--stage` is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1589  directory; otherwise the rebuild is read-only and the result goes to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1590  a derived local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1593  Repository path override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1596  Masterkey file override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1599  Concurrency cap override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1602  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1605  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1609  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1610
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1611  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1612  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1613  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1614  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1615  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1616
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1617  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1618  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1619  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1620  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1621
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1622  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1623  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1624  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1626  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1629  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1633  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1634
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1635  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1636  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1637  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1640  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1641

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1643  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1655  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1656  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1657
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1658  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1659  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1660  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1661  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1662  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1663  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1664  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1665  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1666  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1667  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1668
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1669  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1670  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1671  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1672
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1673  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1674  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1675  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1676  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1677  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1679  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1680  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1683  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1686  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1687  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1688  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1689  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1690  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1691  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1692  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1695  With `--json`, emit the aggregate summary variant instead of the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1696  full document: totals, one record per machine and per source, and

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1698  variant is named `"summary"` in the object.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1717  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1718
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1719  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1720  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1721  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1722  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1723  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1724  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1726  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1730  Build or inspect the per-destination local full-text index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1735  Backfill an opt-in source's older history through its own app
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1736  (ADR-058 D1). Only Grok Bot exists today.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1737
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1738  The Grok Bot local cache is a bounded window, and every position
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1739  that fell out of it is gone from disk for good — but the server
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1740  still holds the conversation, and whenever the app opens one, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1741  app itself fetches the conversation's whole user-visible span into
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1742  view. `backfill grok-bot` relaunches the app with a debugging
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1743  connection that listens only on this machine, opens one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1744  conversation at a time exactly as a person clicking the sidebar
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1745  would, waits while the app loads it, and delivers the rows the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1746  archive does not already hold — marked as backfilled, through the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1747  same session identity a collect uses, so nothing is added twice and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1748  an ordinary collect after a backfill stays incremental.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1749
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1750  **The default is a dry run**: with no extra flags the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1751  read-only traversal runs — it too relaunches and drives the app —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1752  and it only reports (per conversation: rows it would add, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1753  loaded span versus the locally held span, and the positions that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1754  will stay missing). Rows are delivered only with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1755  `--i-accept-the-risk`, which is what the public doc names, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1756  risk statement is printed before every run, a dry run included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1757
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1758  The run is user-started only: no schedule, daemon or config path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1759  can reach it. The app is restored to a normal launch at the end of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1760  every run — including Ctrl-C, where what has been delivered stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1761  delivered. The interior positions the vendor's service never sends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1762  the app stay missing and the session's gap record and `partial`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1763  fidelity stand: the archive never claims completeness.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1764
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1765  Exit codes: `0` every selected conversation loaded and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1766  reported (or delivered) · `1` the traversal finished with findings
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1767  — a conversation that never finished loading within its wait and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1768  was skipped whole, a `--conversation` prefix that matched nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1769  a restore that could not be verified — or the app could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1770  restored to a normal launch · `2` usage (including a `--stage`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1771  that is not a directory) · `3` the run refused (macOS only, app
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1772  not installed, a signed-in app unconfirmable, the debug endpoint
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1773  unusable) or stopped before finishing — a user interrupt or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1774  app-layout change; partial work is kept and reported.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1776  The harness whose app-driven backfill this runs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1777  Only `grok-bot` exists today.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1780  Existing stage directory receiving the sealed shards. Never

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1788  Restrict the run to the conversations named by these id
