help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1811  Hide one archived session from ordinary readers (ADR-046 draft,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1812  Phase 1). Reversible: `unhide` restores it and no archive byte is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1813  touched — `read`, `search`, `export`, the UI and the full-text index
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1814  omit the session while the state is in force.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1815
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1816  The state is a durable control record appended to this machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1817  `meta/<machine>/deletion-control-v1.jsonl` in the stage; the next
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1818  ordinary `push` archives it with the stage, and every machine honors
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1819  it from the destination's control stream. The identity is exact: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1820  session id as named, in one machine partition — a session with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1821  same id in another partition is not affected, and no id is ever
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1822  prefix-matched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1823
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1824  Exit codes: `0` the state is recorded (or the local stream already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1825  holds it — idempotent, no new record) · `1` the record could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1826  appended durably · `2` usage (`--stage` missing or not a directory,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1827  an invalid identity, a reason over 80 bytes) · `3` this machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1828  identity could not be established, or the existing control stream is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1829  unreadable — a failed-closed append that never writes over an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1830  unknown state.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1832  Stage directory whose meta tree receives the control record.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1833  Must already exist; a stage is never created by this command.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1836  Exact session id to hide, as it appears in the archive. Never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1837  prefix-matched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1839  Machine partition of the recording writer (`meta/<machine>/`),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1840  as for every stage-writing command; also the partition of the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1841  target identity unless `--target-machine` names another one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1844  Machine partition of the target identity
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1845  (`sessions/<machine>/<session-id>/`) when it is not the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1846  recording machine's own partition. Default: the value of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1847  `--machine`, else this machine's partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1850  Short reason label recorded with the state. It is metadata the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1851  user chose to keep; at most 80 bytes on one line, never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1852  conversation text.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1856  Restore one hidden session to ordinary readers (ADR-046 draft,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1857  Phase 1). Appends a later control record; it rewrites nothing, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1858  session's archived bytes were never touched by `hide`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1859
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1860  Exit codes as for `hide`: `0` recorded or already visible · `1` the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1861  record could not be appended durably · `2` usage · `3` identity or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1862  control stream unreadable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1864  Stage directory whose meta tree receives the control record.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1867  Exact session id to unhide, as it appears in the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1869  Machine partition of the recording writer, as for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1870  stage-writing command; also the partition of the target identity
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1871  unless `--target-machine` names another one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1874  Machine partition of the target identity when it is not the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1875  recording machine's own partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1878  Short reason label recorded with the state.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1882  Purge one named session from selected destinations — a dry-run
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1883  preview only (W402 interaction design). It reads every selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1884  destination and reports, per destination, whether the exact named
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1885  identity was **found** (with shard-file and byte counts across every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1886  snapshot that holds it), **absent** (proved by a complete read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1887  every snapshot), or **unknown** (the destination could not be read to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1888  completion — never spelled "absent"). It deletes nothing and writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1889  nothing: no archive, stage, destination or index is changed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1890
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1891  **The default is the dry run, and this build has no other mode.**
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1892  The destructive purge — the exclusive maintenance gate, the tombstone
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1893  publication barrier, snapshot rewrite, forget and prune (ADR-046
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1894  draft Phase 3) — is not implemented. `--confirm SESSION` exists so
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1895  that asking for the real deletion gets the phase boundary, not an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1896  unknown-flag error; it is refused and this build deletes nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1897  ever.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1898
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1899  The identity is exact: the session id as named, in one machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1900  partition (`--machine`; default this machine's) — same-id sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1901  in other partitions are not the target. Destinations are explicit:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1902  repeat `--destination`, or pass `--all-destinations`; there is no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1903  implicit destination set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1904
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1905  Exit codes: `0` every selected destination was read to completion
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1906  (each reported `found`, a would-purge inventory, or `absent`) ·
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1907  `2` usage (no destinations selected, both selection modes at once, an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1908  unknown destination name, a `--confirm` value that does not name
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1909  the exact session) · `3` `--confirm` was refused (the destructive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1910  transaction does not exist in this build), or a destination could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1911  not be read to completion — the target's status there is unknown,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1912  and an absence proves nothing. `1` is not used by this command.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1914  Exact session id to purge. Never prefix-matched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1916  Machine partition of the target identity. Default: this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1917  machine's partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1920  Named destination to inspect, repeatable. Required unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1921  `--all-destinations` is given (or a single-destination config).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1924  Inspect every destination the config declares. Explicit: with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1925  no `--destination` and no `--all-destinations` the command is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1926  usage error, because there is no implicit destination set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1929  Preview and stop. This is also what happens without the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1930  flag; the flag exists so a script can say what it expected.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1933  Real execution — refused in this build. The value must name the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1934  exact session being confirmed; anything else is a usage error
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1935  either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1938  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1941  Repository path override (single-destination mode only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1944  Masterkey file override (single-destination mode only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1947  Concurrency cap override (single-destination mode only).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1954  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1958  Redact an archived session by cutting it at a cutoff and re-sealing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1959  user-edited content as a new version. **Not implemented; refused.**
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1960
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1961  The command surface exists because the design names it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1962  (`docs-dev/redaction-and-recollection.md`, ADR-046 draft §5):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1963  redaction is the destructive transaction of a later phase — record
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1964  the cutoff tombstone, remove the old scoped occurrences from stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1965  and every destination, then seal the replacement. Until that phase
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1966  ships, asking for it gets this refusal rather than an unknown-flag
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1967  error, and nothing is read or changed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1968
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1969  Exit codes: `2` always — a deliberate refusal, not a failure to run:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1970  the operation does not exist in this build.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1972  Exact session id to redact. Never prefix-matched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1974  Machine partition of the target identity. Default: this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1975  machine's partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1981  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1984  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1985
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1986  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1987  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1988  the next time a session is read.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2126  The parameters of the remote step, exactly as the caller supplied them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2127
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2128  Every field here is either a name or a location. **No field can carry a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2129  secret**, and that is the point of the shape rather than an accident of it:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2130  the two credential fields are the *names of environment variables*, which the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2131  wizard writes into the config as `env:NAME` and never resolves itself. So a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2132  secret cannot reach the config file as plaintext, and it cannot reach
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2133  `argv` — where it would be captured by the process list and by any log that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2134  echoes the command — because there is no flag that would accept one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2137  Which recipe to write.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2140  SFTP: `ssh://<host>:<port>`. S3: the service endpoint, e.g.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2141  `https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2144  SFTP only: the ssh user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2147  SFTP only: the private key to authenticate with. Optional — leaving it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2148  out lets the backend use the ssh agent and its own default keys, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2149  a real configuration rather than a gap.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2152  S3 only: the bucket (or container) the repository lives in.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2155  S3 only: the region. R2 is single-region and names it `auto`; another
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2156  S3-compatible service names its own.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2159  Both kinds: the prefix inside the account/bucket that the repository
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2160  lives under. Optional, and omitted rather than defaulted: a prefix the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2161  user did not choose would put their archive somewhere they did not name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2164  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the access key
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2165  id. Not the key id itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2168  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the secret
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2169  access key. Not the secret.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2172  Declare that this host's key was checked out of band, which authorizes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2173  recording it in `~/.ssh/known_hosts`. A declaration, not a verification:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2174  nothing here, and nothing anywhere else, can check that the comparison
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2175  happened. Without it the wizard stops at an unknown host and writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2176  nothing (ADR-039, rejected option E).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:349  command's argument struct so the two commands cannot drift apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:350
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:351  Conflicts are expressed here rather than re-implemented per command:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:352  mixing a local-day flag with a unix-seconds flag is a usage error
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:353  regardless of which command asked.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:356  Match sessions whose id starts with this prefix.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:359  Match one machine partition exactly.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:362  Match these harnesses, comma-separated (e.g. `--harness claude-code,codex`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:363  The harness is the leading `.`/`~` segment of the archived session id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:366  Match an observed runtime surface (ADR-059): the session's records
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:367  must name this exact value in their `surface` dimension. `cli` and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:368  `desktop-cowork` are the claude-code values; the full vocabulary is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:369  the registry's `dimensions.surfaces` union, validated by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:370  [`Self::resolve_validated`] — an unknown value is a usage error,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:371  never an empty result. A session whose records carry no surface at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:372  all (claude-code's CLI library records none) is listed as unplaceable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:373  while this filter is active: an absent observation is not a value.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:374  `--sub-surface` remains an alias.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:377  One local calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Identical to `--since D --until D`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:384  Earliest local calendar day to include, `YYYY-MM-DD`, from that day's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:385  00:00:00 local time.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:388  Latest local calendar day to include, `YYYY-MM-DD`, through that day's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:389  23:59:59 local time.
